notes.title: South of the Circle | Announcement Trailer
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32989971/ad6eef7879d358ba71e9cd898827739f72b781c1.jpg[/img]

Hello, Everyone!

We’re excited and proud to announce yet another jewel in 11 bit studios' lineup of meaningful entertainment titles!

South of the Circle developed by the British BAFTA-winning studio State of Play is a visually impactful and compelling narrative experience featuring a cinematic story about true love and the desire to keep our promises set in the midst of the 1960’s Cold War.

Watch South of the Circle, 11 bit studios Announcement Trailer: 
[previewyoutube=Qk5VoKBZ5xw;full][/previewyoutube]

You’ll play as Peter, a climate scientist who survived a crash-landing and is now traversing across the bone freezing Antarctica. As he’s desperately holding on to his life, the memories of all the past choices that lead him up until this point start resurfacing.

The game’s beautiful aesthetic and nuanced writing underlines its sweeping cinematic scope, further enhanced by actors drawn from “Bohemian Rhapsody” (Gwilym Lee), “The Woman in White” (Olivia Vinall), “The Crown” (Richard Goulding), “Game of Thrones” (Anton Lesser), “Chernobyl” (Adrian Rawlins) and “Downton Abbey” (Michael Fox).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32989971/637bf09edc64ed755ec1674b37804fa338011dce.gif[/img]


South of The Circle is coming soon on consoles and PCs. Find out more about the game and stay updated by adding it to your Steam wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811040



Get ready for a deep multi-layered cinematic experience and remember that some promises stay with you forever.

Take care,
11bit studios

notes.title: Spacecom, our new strategy game is available on Steam
notes.notes:
We have some good news for all the strategy games fans out there! Yesterday we've released Spacecom – a minimalistic space strategy created by Flow Combine and published by 11 bit studios.

It’s a strategic-to-the-bone, starfleet command game with both, entertaining single player and challenging multiplayer. Spacecom is a battle of strategists in which deception, smart movement, and choices to battle decide victory or defeat. No coincidence, no luck – it’s all about preparing a plan and bringing it to life.

You can learn more about the game (and buy it of course!) here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/263860/

notes.title: Reverse-Tower Offence: Anomaly Gets Defensive
notes.notes:
DotA burst forth from the Warcraft III mod scene with a mighty roar and a shower of blood, each drop growing into another independent MOBA, but tower defence games were a more creeping success. Oh sure, they’d been around before, but they bred madly in that weird environment then escaped into the wild. And, much like DotA, what’s followed has never really strayed far from the original formula. 11 Bit Studios played with flipping it in Anomaly: Warzone Earth, controlling soldiers fighting through alien fortifications, but couldn’t resist the lure of tower defence forever.

Its newly-announced Anomaly Defenders is a reverse-tower offence (or a reverse-reverse-tower defence) with the radical idea of building static defences to ward off advancing enemies.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Anomaly 2 Update Released - New Content Available
notes.notes:
Anomaly 2 New Content Available!

Anomaly 2 has just been updated with a new content to Multiplayer mode: Philip's Puzzle map and more.

11 bit studios' Anomaly 2 is a sequel to the critically acclaimed Anomaly Warzone Earth. Maintaining the core elements of the original, Anomaly 2 adds new features to the single-player campaign and finally puts your skills to a test in a completely unique experience: the dynamic tower defense vs. tower offense multiplayer mode. This new update delivers Philips’ Puzzle - brand new PvP Multiplayer map and a set of functionalities that enable players to customize the parametres of each multiplayer battle. Now you can play battles on different conditions - from minimum resources to total war and annihilation strategy.

notes.title: Now Available - Anomaly 2
notes.notes:
Anomaly 2 is Now Available on Steam and to celebrate, it is 10% off for the first week!

Anomaly Warzone Earth owners also receive a additional 10% off when they purchase before May 31st.

As the sequel to Anomaly Warzone Earth, Anomaly 2 adds new features to the single-player campaign and finally puts your skills to a test in a completely unique experience: the dynamic tower defense vs. tower offense multiplayer mode!

In the years following the invasion of Earth in 2018, the planet is overrun by alien machines. Humankind is on the verge of extinction. Banded together in huge convoys, they search the frozen tundra for food and supplies. Since the war, the roles have been reversed: now our species seems to be the Anomaly on a machine-controlled planet. Your convoy, Commander, is called Yukon.

*Offer ends May 22nd at 10AM Pacific Time.
